supersedes: v2 for current semantic main track; retain v2 as historical I_class membership control, no past result relabeling.
shared_operator: I_present with task-defined complete command and scope constraints; independent semantic supervision, never native-class projection

native_final.input: Direct audio plus all31 native category descriptors, native unspecified values explained as classification convention; no claim that proposed semantic cards are native necessary-and-sufficient definitions.
native_final.output: one model_Final typed choice among all31 commands
native_final.truth: Official target native label, preserved even when independent semantic meaning differs.
native_final.keep_semantic_unknown: No native sample excluded because semantic_Q is unavailable, conflict or unassessed; native population never shrunk using model errors.

semantic_Q.output: boolean per configured Span; unavailable is a supervision mask, not automatic third predicted class
semantic_Q.truth: Independent reviewed semantic presence for each definition and reference, with explicit recording-binding and evidence scope; not native one-hot.
semantic_Q.source_truth: Neither native truth nor author boundary exemplars admit labels; all248 TRAIN references remain unassessed in initial packet.
semantic_Q.location_none: The matching request leaves location unspecified; this is an explicit constraint, not a wildcard, missing annotation or evidence of real-world absence.
semantic_Q.multi_request: Per expressed request; distinct room-specific and room-unspecified requests can each match. Never impose whole-utterance one-hot or silently choose main intent.
semantic_Q.missing: Keep unavailable/conflict/unassessed/transport failure separate; no implicit false.
semantic_Q.unexpressed_domain: Bare Play/Resume/Stop/Pause or Turn it up/down cannot use native labels to resolve domain.
semantic_Q.relation_to_native: No hard fold, pruning, repair or primary-command choice from predicates. All-false semantic panel does not imply OOD.
semantic_Q.slots: No FSC action/object/location enum substitution for S_present. This first migration tests I_present and native Final only; semantic slot transfer remains a separate dataset requirement.

structure.knowledge: Identical complete native31 menu plus panel semantic cards and complete shared policy for each paired arm.
structure.output: Direct Final only; Q_input all panel I_present Spans then native Final in one forward.
structure.assignment: All8 fixed panels for every target audio, no gold/reference/topic routing; four questions except final three.
structure.aggregate: Per-panel Final metrics and equal-panel mean, no best panel, vote, union or multi-call complete-set claim.
structure.checkpoint_comparison: Compare Stage1 and source Q_input/Q_credit RL checkpoints under the same target templates; Q_credit is a source training condition, not target reward optimization.
structure.calls: 8 per audio per target arm per checkpoint; token/compute cost and mismatch from source4I+4S inputs disclosed.

metrics.unknown: Masked only in semantic metrics; keep complete original denominator and missing/conflict counts visible.
metrics.invalid: Native wrong; semantic positive FN, negative invalid separately from FPR; balanced-accuracy wrong. Do not fabricate a label.
metrics.panels: Exact-match/sets only on fully admitted panel truth. Not31-predicate one-call prediction.
metrics.dependence: Repeated scripts and speaker clustering reported; target TRAIN inspection disclosed as schema authoring, not unseen-task discovery.

shared_arithmetic.native_accuracy: official legal triple accuracy over unchanged full recording population; per-panel plus equal-panel mean
shared_arithmetic.semantic_macro: equal mean over fixed positive-supported definitions, not unweighted mean of four-question and three-question panel macros

target_usage: TRAIN references and ontology may inform definitions, no target model-performance feedback used for template/checkpoint/algorithm selection. Target weights frozen. TEST annotation is evaluation-only under frozen definitions, blind to predictions; discovered ambiguity stays masked rather than prompting in-place rule edits.

input_packet.role: TRAIN offline annotation inputs only, not actor prompts or execution acceptance

test_status: No TEST CSV/reference/audio opened for this revision; historical FSC exposure remains disclosed. Full official evaluation population identity/scoring and semantic annotation pending.
